provenance.command: docker run --rm --network none -e GOTOOLCHAIN=local -e GOPROXY=off -e GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly -e GOMODCACHE=/modcache -e GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache -v <modcache>:/modcache:ro -v <git archive 981d25c go.mod go.sum cmd internal pkg, plus the scratch in-package capture test cmd/server/zz_lanec_capture_test.go>:/src:ro -v <out>:/out -w /src <image> go test -count=1 -run ^TestLaneCCapture$ ./cmd/server/
capture_notes: floats are IEEE-754 bit patterns in lowercase hex (Go math.Float64bits); risk inputs include NaN (Go math.NaN 0x7ff8000000000001), the infinities and values whose (risk-20)/15 overflows int64
realEvent[].proof, behavior[].proof and the scenario request bodies are the exact JSON bytes decoded by Go; outputs bind the inputs
behavior[] ran applyPassBehavior on a fresh app per proof; signals are the appended network signals and scoring is the stored engine result
velocity[] ran applyPassVelocity on one app at base+offsetMs; velLevel -1 means the pass session was never created (level 0 returns before passStore.get)

scenarios[] drove the real app.routes() handlers through httptest on newApp; nonces lists the /api/pass/new challenge nonces in issue order (crypto/rand), which the Rust replay injects; every request ran within one wall-clock second recorded as nowUnix (the capture retried a scenario that crossed a second boundary)
scenarios with stepUp true set app.stepUpKey to constants.stepUpKey; the receipt expiry is nowUnix+120
the PoW solutions inside recorded /api/pass/pow bodies came from internal/pow Solve; the Rust replay sends the recorded bytes
provenance.scope: Frozen oracle outputs for differential parity only; never regenerate to hide drift
provenance.committed_transform: The committed outputs equal capture.json except that scenarios[].steps[].json is removed: it was a parsed copy of the same step response bytes (fromjson of response for every application/json step, null otherwise), so nothing recorded is lost. It was removed because the parsed copy placed derived attestation tokens next to a "token" key, which the repository secret scan reports as generic API keys; the tokens are HMAC outputs under the readable test master key in outputs.constants, not credentials. The replay decides JSON comparison from contentType.
